messages.content: Generate a DNA sequence with 100 bases including more G (Guanine) and C (Cytosine).

function.name: generate_DNA_sequence
function.description: Generate a random DNA sequence with a specific length and nucleotide preference.

length.description: The length of the DNA sequence to be generated.

preferences.description: Preferred nucleotides to include more frequently in the DNA sequence.

message.reasoning_content: The user wants a DNA sequence of 100 bases with more G and C nucleotides. I need to use the generate_DNA_sequence function. The parameters are length and preferences. Length is 100. Preferences should be an array of strings: ["G", "C"]? The user says "including more G (Guanine) and C (Cytosine)". That suggests we want more G and C, but not necessarily exclusively. The preferences parameter is an array of nucleotides to include more frequently. I think we can set preferences as ["G", "C"] to bias towards G and C. However, the function description says "preferred nucleotides to include more frequently in the DNA sequence." So we can specify both G and C. Let's do that. We'll generate a random DNA sequence of length 100 with preferences ["G", "C"]. Let's call the function.
